feature: Slot-addressed Edem provider settings on the control server
scope: Advertise the native_provider_settings capability and compare or save one Edem account transactionally through the shared provider field codec. The code stays in the existing remote-settings asset and classic entry; provider, optional and Modern caps are unchanged.

baseline.method: npm run build at 80f56b37, the parent of the feature commit, measuring the emitted dist/player.js.

remoteSettings.method: The same build, measuring the emitted dist/remote-settings.js.

candidate.method: npm run build at the feature commit, measuring the emitted dist/player.js.

remoteSettings.method: The same build, measuring the emitted dist/remote-settings.js.

reason: The feature commit advertised the capability and saved the Edem account from the classic entry and the remote-settings asset, which the existing budgets did not cover. The allowance is the measured delta of both assets, counted once in the entry, legacy-complete and complete caps; the provider, optional, Modern and per-family limits stay unchanged.
